Ana (PM): Quick sync — we need a short spec for function-call backpressure, timeouts, and fallback semantics before we lock the API for beta. Customers are asking for predictable failure modes and a simple way to opt into model-only fallbacks. Link: https://redwood.internal/notes/toolcall-backpressure :eyes:
Sam (Eng): +1. Proposal: include per-call timeout_ms and priority. If tool doesn't respond within timeout -> return status: timeout and optionally attach model_response (if we ran model fallback). Also support an async mode where we enqueue call and push result later via webhook.
Priya (ML): Telemetry must surface: tool latency, failure reason (non-200, exception, schema mismatch), and whether model fallback was used. Need event names: tool.call.start, tool.call.result, tool.call.fallback. Also capture call_schema_version.
Jordan (Platform): Suggest adding a route-level fallback_policy config: {"policy":"never|on_error|on_timeout|always","model_variant":"gpt-sim"}. This lets Dedicated customers opt for "never" to preserve determinism.
Maria (EngOps): For launch gating, we need clear error envelopes and a developer-facing SDK that exposes both raw events and a consolidated result. Example response envelope:

```
{
  "call_id": "c123",
  "status": "tool_ok", // tool_ok | tool_error | timeout | schema_mismatch | fallback_used
  "tool_result": {"text":"..."},
  "model_response": {"text":"..."}, // populated if fallback ran or model augmented
  "latency_ms": 312,
  "tool_latency_ms": 300,
  "error_code": "HTTP_502"
}
```

Sam (Eng): Also need streaming semantics: emit partial events like `tool.result.partial` so clients can stream tool stdout. For SDK, provide a unified iterator that yields {event_type, payload}.
Priya (ML): Edge case: schema mismatch — we should include the original tool output and a `parsing_error` field. For privacy/compliance, default is to drop tool raw payload unless customer enables `raw_tool_payload=true` on route.
Ana (PM): Launch checklist draft: 1) Spec doc + examples 2) Stable call envelope v1 3) SDK support (js/py) 4) Telemetry events wired to Console 5) Canary with two enterprise customers 6) Backwards-compatibility plan for schema bumps. Anyone object? :thumbsup:
Jordan (Platform): No objections. I'll owner the route config and fallback_policy impl.
Sam (Eng): I'll take the call envelope + streaming implementation.
Priya (ML): I'll own telemetry names and dashboard panels.
Maria (EngOps): I'll draft SDK error mapping and the beta rollout plan with canary sigs.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: infra/tools-call-fallback-v1 -> canary at 2025-04-02T18:00Z
Ana (PM): Great — please drop PR links and a short demo script. We'll aim to ship beta once canary is stable and telemetry shows <1% unexpected failures. Thanks! :rocket:
